sloka: अवतीर्यं च धर्मात्मा तस्माच्छैलात् स राघवः ।परैः परमदुर्धर्षं ददर्श बलमात्मनः ।। ६.४१.२३ ।।।।
transliteration: avatīryaṁ ca dharmātmā tasmācchailāt sa rāghavaḥ ।paraiḥ paramadurdharṣaṁ dadarśa balamātmanaḥ ।। 6.41.23 ।।।।

translations.english: Mighty hero Rama, (the elder brother of Lakshmana) said to Lakshmana in this manner (as described earlier) and descended from the peak of the mountain without delay.
